Welcome to Blade Swarm, the ultimate survival roguelike on Roblox! In this world, you are the center of the storm. Surround yourself with a lethal orbit of floating weaponry and carve your way through infinite legions of monsters.

The faster they run at you, the faster they fall. How long can you survive the swarm?

Loot & Level: Slain enemies burst into Gold and Loot Crates. Use your riches to upgrade your blade's orbit speed, size, and damage.
